summary: KKR Private Equity Conglomerate LLC filed an 8-K solely to disclose the determination of its Transactional Net Asset Value per share for eight share classes as of March 31, 2026, ranging from $34.03 to $36.94. The filing provides routine periodic NAV updates, not a special situation event. There are no M&A, activist, tender, spin-off, restructuring, or other transformative corporate actions. The registrant issued no securities, changed no management, and announced no strategic review. This is a standard current report disclosing financial information, comparable to a U.S. closed-end fund's NAV release, with no deal mechanics, premium, or expected close.
